The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1986–87 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[PSV Eindhoven]] won the championship. At the beginning of the season, AZ '67 from [[Alkmaar]] changed their name to [[AZ (football club)|AZ]].
